build.reason: The recipe builds a static Expat library and compiles this C entry with its required UTF-8 macro. The changed source retains the called API signatures; this is a static compatibility assessment, not a claimed build result.

input.reason: The entry passes generated bytes and their size to parser calls; the changed parse function validates its arguments and accepts zero length.

lifecycle.reason: The entry creates parent, namespace, and external parsers, calls the helper on each, frees children before the parent, and resets only a live parser. Child creation records its live parent.

control_flow.reason: The entry reaches parsing, but its one nonfinal call followed by a final call cannot reach the new deferral outcome after a partial-token attempt.

accepted.requirement: Exercise the default-enabled reparse deferral mechanism for a partial XML token through successive nonfinal parse calls on the same parser.
accepted.target_route: A finite XML document with a long token can be split across nonfinal XML_Parse calls; after the first incomplete-token attempt, a later small nonfinal increment with buffer capacity available can make have_now less than twice had_before and defer processing.
accepted.failure_condition: ParseOneInput passes all bytes once with isFinal=0 and then all bytes again with isFinal=1. The first call starts with had_before=0, so it cannot defer; the second call bypasses the deferral guard because finalBuffer is true. The entry repeats this pattern on freshly created parsers.
accepted.alternative_paths: The namespace and external parsers use the same helper sequence. External parser creation copies the enabled setting but initializes a fresh partial-token count. Zero-length input, reset, and the final call provide no equivalent later nonfinal attempt.

assumptions: The supplied build environment behaves normally as specified; no allocator or file-system failure is used as a witness.
